enum: On Demand with User Initiated Start
record.description:
Call recording scenario.
 * `Always` - Incoming and outgoing calls will be recorded with no control to start, stop, pause, or resume.
 * `Never` - Calls will not be recorded.
 * `Always with Pause/Resume` - Calls are always recorded, but user can pause or resume the recording. Stop recording is not supported.
 * `On Demand with User Initiated Start` - Records only the portion of the call after the recording start (`*44`) has been entered. Pause, resume, and stop controls are supported.

recordVoicemailEnabled.description: When `true`, voicemail messages are also recorded.

type.description:
Type of pause/resume notification. If `enabled` is `true` and `type` is not provided then `type` is set to `Beep` by default.
 * `Beep` - A beep sound is played when call recording is paused or resumed.
 * `Play Announcement` - A verbal announcement is played when call recording is paused or resumed.

enabled.description: `true` when notification feature is in effect. `false` indicates notification is disabled.

interval.description: Interval at which warning tone "beep" will be played. This interval is an integer from 10 to 1800 seconds

enabled.description: `true` when ongoing call recording tone will be played at the designated interval. `false` indicates no warning tone will be played.

internalCallsEnabled.description: When `true`, an announcement is played when call recording starts and an announcement is played when call recording ends for internal calls.

pstnCallsEnabled.description: When `true`, an announcement is played when call recording starts and an announcement is played when call recording ends for PSTN calls.

startStopAnnouncement.description: Call Recording starts and stops announcement settings.
